message: ガンスでゴンス

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
In the morning, standing under the eaves of Yuugiri-an, my shoulders slump.

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no, it's not like we had plans or anything... Sorry for dropping by unannounced.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll head on ahead, then. Tell Nanaka I said hi.」

name: Synn
message: 「It's been a while since I walked to school alone.」
I pass through Shiokumi Shopping District and head onto the route to school. I'm running a bit later than usual today.
This morning, Nanaka didn't come to my room.
Still, worried about how things went with Misa, I couldn't wait around and went all the way to Yuugiri-an to pick her up.

name: Synn
message: 「Thank goodness you're okay. I was worried you might've gotten hurt on the way over.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Wouldn't that have been better than this?」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-That's not true.」

name: Paqy
message: 「From the looks of things, Soba didn't pull it off.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」
She overslept and just jumped out of bed. She wants me to go on ahead without worrying about her. That's what her old man told me.
I didn't see Nanaka herself. Strangely enough, I didn't sense any frantic rushing coming from her room on the second floor either.
I tried to wait until Nanaka finished getting ready, only for her dad to start worrying about me being late instead.

name: Paqy
message: 「Are you really okay with this?」

name: Synn
message: 「If she says to go on ahead, I'll trust Nanaka and do just that.」

name: Synn
message: 「If I'd stayed there waiting, I would've made her dad worry unnecessarily--thinking something might've happened between Nanaka and me.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Something practically did happen, didn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, about Misa--」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not that. Before trusting Soba, Your Majesty the Demon Lord ought to trust yourself first.」
Paqy doesn't say another word after that, and perhaps thanks to it, my pace quickens.

name: Ria
message: 「...Y-You two...!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawawa. Whatever is going on here?」

name: Misa
message: 「Why can't you scrape together the budget to allocate to the drama club?! Do your job as treasurer properly!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I already admitted my mistake, didn't I?! How long are you gonna keep nitpicking and picking a fight with me?!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm telling you to fulfill your bare minimum responsibility. Redo the budget allocations for every single club and society participating in the Holy Night Festival.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We don't gotta go that far! You seriously think we'll make it in time for Christmas if we start a retake right now!?」

name: Misa
message: 「This only happened because you handed out funds so recklessly, Nanaka!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're the one who's narrow-minded and arrogant, Misa! Do something about that thick skull of yours.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「All you ever think about is playing it safe. That's not our 'real deal' at all. If you can't make the big calls, then just quit being Vice President already.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What did you just say--!?」

name: Ria
message: 「That's going too far, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No it's not!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Instead of trusting everyone to handle things, you can't stand it unless you butt in and boss them around on everything. Doesn't that mean you don't trust a single person!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Running the Holy Night Festival like that won't be any fun at all. Fact is, working as Treasurer under you, I don't feel any joy in being part of the Student Council.」

name: Misa
message: 「You're the one trying to please everyone, Nanaka! All you do is watch everyone's expressions so you won't be disliked!」

name: Misa
message: 「That's why people took advantage of your softness and the budget is near collapse, isn't it!? You completely lack the sense of responsibility required of a leader.」

name: Misa
message: 「If you don't have the courage to play the bad guy, you should hand the Treasurer's seat over to someone else!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was that--!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey...! That's going too far, Misa.」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, stop it, both of you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, Nanaka! What good does it do tearing each other apart when we're fellow members of the Student Council!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right! If you keep acting like this, there's no way the Holy Night Festival will go well!」

name: Ria
message: 「What on earth happened? Try talking to me about it, okay?」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Well, that is...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uh, well...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, Nanaka...」

name: Ria
message: 「I see. Understood. So it's something you can't even tell me, your advisor.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Senpai...」

name: Misa
message: 「Onee-sama...」

name: Ria
message: 「That's all for today's Student Council. I think both of you should cool your heads a bit.」

name: Misa
message: 「...I'm going home!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmph, I'm going home too!」

name: Ria
message: 「They both left. Come on, we're going after them, Synn-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes! Huh...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The Vice President and the Treasurer split off cleanly to the left and right, didn't they?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, listen closely.」

name: Ria
message: 「Both Misa-chan and Nanaka-chan are dutiful, so there's no way they'd talk while the Student Council is in session.」

name: Ria
message: 「However, if they start ignoring each other, things will become irreparable!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, please take care of Misa-chan. I'll go after Nanaka-chan!」
I catch up right away. Misa is leaning against the wall, trembling, having stopped walking.

name: Synn
message: 「I got lucky--usually I can't catch up to you.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-Why did you come after me... You should be chasing after Nanaka-san!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, I--」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't come any closer! If you take even one more step toward me, I... I'll hate you, Sakura-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Then...」
Then how do you feel about me right now?
I want to ask that, but I can't. Repairing the relationship between Misa and Nanaka takes top priority over me.

name: Misa
message: 「Hurry up, turn right around and go to Nanaka-san!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No.」

name: Misa
message: 「Why can't you understand something even this simple, Sakura-kun!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Who do you think it's thanks to that we're even able to talk like this now, when things used to be so awkward between us?!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm... fine now, okay... Just leave me alone...!」
Still leaning against the wall, Misa staggers awkwardly toward the stairs as if struggling just to move.
All I could do was stand rooted right where I was.

name: Ria
message: 「I'm sorry, Synn-kun. I couldn't get Nanaka-chan to talk to me...」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, I'll figure something out for the two of them. It's my responsibility to fix this.」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yes, hellooo.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hello, Sacchin?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa, you sound pretty serious. Did something happen?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, well, the thing is--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「--and that's how it ended up. I talked all big in front of Synn, and it totally backfired on me...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh... How did things turn out like this?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nooo idea~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin, come on...!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, it's between a guy and a girl who like each other, right? As an outsider, I'm just gonna kick back and enjoy the show~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-You're acting like it's none of your business!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehehe, well, come on--you wouldn't actually be happy if I took your side, right, Nana-chan?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well, that's...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Aaaand if I took the vice president's side, you wouldn't be happy about that either... Right? Am I right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...I'm sure blessed with a great best friend.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「But Misa...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You know how Misa always puts her guard up a little around everyone, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Which means... she probably doesn't have a friend like you, Sacchin, does she?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Thinking about your love rival again--just how good-natured can you get?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-Is there something wrong with being too nice?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nope, nothing's wrong with that. What's bad is how you hate that part of yourself, Nana-chan.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So please, learn to love them. Both yourself and the vice president.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Got it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thanks, Sacchin. For listening to all my stuff. Think I'll actually be able to sleep tonight thanks to you.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehehe, what are besties like us for, Nana-chan?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, night. Sacchin.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Goodnight, Nana-chan.」
